officialGovernmentPAC2026Benchmark.source: Government of India, India Meteorological Department, Positional Astronomy Centre — 2026 official daily Nirayana longitude PDFs
officialGovernmentPAC2026Benchmark.interpretation: This existing certificate is accepted as the official 2026 contemporary Nirayana benchmark. It is not re-run or re-acquired in this PR. It does not prove a historical Saura four-pass True Longitude, a same-model Mean/True/Sheeghroccheya chain, or every natal epoch from 1800–2399.

acquisitionPolicy.instruction: Do not search for or acquire the 1971, 1974, 1992, 1994 or 2015 IENA/IAE editions for this task. Reuse the already-certified Government PAC 2026 benchmark.

exactNatalEpochModernDe440Parity.comparison: Geocentric tropical apparent ecliptic-of-date longitude, with both engines supplied the same ET/TT Julian Day at each sampled historical birth instant
exactNatalEpochModernDe440Parity.randomSelection: The exact seeded-random DOB/time/India-place records already present in the annual 600-chart artifact; no replacement samples
exactNatalEpochModernDe440Parity.interpretation: A modern JPL DE440 numerical parity cross-check at these 3,000 exact natal-epoch planet rows. It is not a printed historical Saura table oracle and does not certify the classical four-pass True Longitude or the all-natal Mean/True/Sheeghroccheya chain.
exactNatalEpochModernDe440Parity.classicalComparisonSeparation: The DE440 apparent True longitude is reported as a separate modern-model result. It is not substituted into the same-model Bīja Mean/Sheeghroccheya BPHS Chesta chain.

coherentClassicalChainValidation.internalAssertions: Every exact JD and frame field is equal across Mean, Mandocca, Sheeghroccheya and the four-pass True model; BPHS Chesta is recomputed only from these three same-model longitudes.

secondary24JyaCrossCheck.method: Printed 24-Jya interpolation versus continuous trigonometric four-pass, supplied identical classical inputs
secondary24JyaCrossCheck.interpretation: The one 0.0532319-degree difference is retained as a table-interpolation diagnostic; it is not normalized away. The full same-epoch/same-frame input-chain and BPHS arithmetic audit completed across all 3,000 rows.

coherentClassicalChainValidation.artifact: The result is appended to the 600-chart artifact by the research test.
